entries.title: Job 19:1
segments: ¶And Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 19:2
segments: How long will ye vex my soul, and crush me with words?

entries.title: Job 19:3
segments: These ten times have ye reproached me; ye are not ashamed to stupefy me.

entries.title: Job 19:4
segments: And be it [that] I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.

entries.title: Job 19:5
segments: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and prove against me my reproach,

entries.title: Job 19:6
segments: Know now that +God hath overthrown me, and hath surrounded me with his net.

entries.title: Job 19:7
segments: Behold, I cry out of wrong, and I am not heard; I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.

entries.title: Job 19:8
segments: ¶He hath hedged up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.

entries.title: Job 19:9
segments: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

entries.title: Job 19:10
segments: He breaketh me down on every side, and I am gone; and my hope hath he torn up as a tree.

entries.title: Job 19:11
segments: And he hath kindled his anger against me, and hath counted me unto him as one of his enemies.

entries.title: Job 19:12
segments: His troops have come together and cast up their way against me, and have encamped round about my tent.

entries.title: Job 19:13
segments: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are quite estranged from me.

entries.title: Job 19:14
segments: My kinsfolk have failed, and my known friends have forgotten me.

entries.title: Job 19:15
segments: The sojourners in my house and my maids count me as a stranger; I am an alien in their sight.

entries.title: Job 19:16
segments: I called my servant, and he answered not; I entreated him with my mouth.

entries.title: Job 19:17
segments: My breath is strange to my wife, and my entreaties to the children of my [mother's] womb.

entries.title: Job 19:18
segments: Even young children despise me; I rise up, and they speak against me.

entries.title: Job 19:19
segments: All my intimate friends abhor me, and they whom I loved are turned against me.

entries.title: Job 19:20
segments: My bones cleave to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.

entries.title: Job 19:21
segments: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, ye my friends; for the hand of +God hath touched me.

entries.title: Job 19:22
segments: Why do ye persecute me as *God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

entries.title: Job 19:23
segments: ¶Oh would that my words were written! oh that they were inscribed in a book!

entries.title: Job 19:24
segments: That with an iron style and lead they were graven in the rock for ever!

entries.title: Job 19:25
segments: And [as for] me, I know that my Redeemer liveth, and the Last, he shall stand upon the earth;

entries.title: Job 19:26
segments: And [if] after my skin this shall be destroyed, yet from out of my flesh shall I see +God;

entries.title: Job 19:27
segments: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another: --my reins are consumed within me.

entries.title: Job 19:28
segments: If ye say, How shall we persecute him? when the root of the matter is found in me,

entries.title: Job 19:29
segments: Be ye yourselves afraid of the sword! for the sword is fury against misdeeds, that ye may know there is a judgment.
